description: Peers' open history edits as a shell tells them (ticket 26/09/30 NON-DESTRUCTIVE-HISTORY-EDITING, W2-B follow-up 2 / W2-C follow-up 2). The presence wire carries only `historyEdit {mutationId, stage, drafts}` (bit 13), never locale text: each shell labels an editing peer from its OWN history `rows`. `expect.<locale>.chips` is every editing peer's roster activity, in peer order (its `text` is part of the chip's accessible name, its `badge` marks the row); a peer without a history edit has none. `expect.<locale>.notes` is the note each history-body node gets, by node key (`framework.history.entry.<seq>` for the row holding the mutation, `framework.history.mutation.<mutationId>` for the mutation itself), sorted by key, one key's lines joined by ` · ` in peer order. Every text is a `ui.timeTravel.peer.{editingTarget,editingHistory,editingRow}` label of the one table in `🧫️time-travel-band` (`labels`), at the normal tier.
